science.summary: New research from the University of St Andrews, in collaboration with the University of Copenhagen, the North Coast Cetacean Society and Fisheries and Oceans Canada, has sequenced a whole whale genome using samples of "whale snot" collected by small drones off the coast of British Columbia—a world first.

science.title: Baby, she's back: SpaceX catches a Starship from orbit for first time
science.summary: SpaceX brought back its Starship rocket's second stage today for a first-ever midair capture at its launch pad, capping a record-setting orbital flight test.

science.title: A material just one atom thick reveals a strange quantum secret
science.summary: Researchers at the University of Osaka have discovered a remarkable quantum state forming at the boundary between a one-atom-thick material and a metal. They observed electrons behaving as though they were unusually heavy, including a previously unseen state created by interactions between the ultrathin layer and the copper beneath it. science.title: Tigers, zebras, quantum dots: Nanoparticles assemble into patterns
science.summary: Forget about how the zebra got its stripes. For a group of Cornell engineers, an equally important question is: What drives the formation of such eye-catching patterns?
